description: This file contains a series of tests for Git command-line functionalities, specifically testing commands like 'tag', 'branch', and 'for-each-ref' with various options and argument scenarios. It sets up a testing environment, executes commands with different parameters, and verifies expected outcomes and error messages.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Runs a test expecting the command(s) to succeed, verifies output and error streams.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail, and checks the error output.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Checks that a file contains a specific number of lines.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern within a file's contents, used to verify error messages.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with a specified message to set up the test environment.
